title: forsythia japonica f. ovata
intro: Forsythia japonica f. ovata, commonly known as Korean forsythia, is a deciduous shrub that belongs to the family Oleaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, exhibiting various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Korean forsythia include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Korean forsythia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
